crossRefs.note: My heart overflows with a noble theme. I recite my verses for the king. My tongue is like the pen of a skillful writer.
God, you have rejected us. You have broken us down. You have been angry. Restore us, again.
Hear us, Shepherd of Israel, you who lead Joseph like a flock, you who sit above the cherubim, shine out.
I sink in deep mire, where there is no foothold. I have come into deep waters, where the floods overflow me.
Deliver me out of the mire, and don’t let me sink. Let me be delivered from those who hate me, and out of the deep…
Don’t let the flood waters overwhelm me, neither let the deep swallow me up. Don’t let the pit shut its mouth on me.
The cords of death surrounded me. The floods of ungodliness made me afraid.
Deep calls to deep at the noise of your waterfalls. All your waves and your billows have swept over me.
I will make justice the measuring line, and righteousness the plumb line. The hail will sweep away the refuge of lies…
When you pass through the waters, I will be with you, and through the rivers, they will not overflow you. When you walk…
Waters flowed over my head. I said, “I am cut off.”
For you threw me into the depths, in the heart of the seas. The flood was all around me. All your waves and your…
The serpent spewed water out of his mouth after the woman like a river, that he might cause her to be carried away by…
The earth helped the woman, and the earth opened its mouth and swallowed up the river which the dragon spewed out of…
He said to me, “The waters which you saw, where the prostitute sits, are peoples, multitudes, nations, and languages.

translations.web: Save me, God, for the waters have come up to my neck!
translations.bsb: Save me, O God, for the waters are up to my neck.
translations.kjv: Save me, O God; for the waters are come in unto my soul.
translations.asv: Save me, O God; For the waters are come in unto my soul.
